consistencyCheck.note: Seat histogram recomputed independently from the assignment matrices reproduces ALARM's published statistics exactly.

discreteTail.note: The enacted map ties the ensemble's observed minimum: no simulated plan produces fewer, and a small number produce the same count. The count is an estimate of a tail probability from few events — the interval, not the raw count, is the defensible statement.

continuousTail.measure: Democratic two-party share of the 4th-ranked district — the district that would have to flip to add a Democratic seat
continuousTail.note: Simulated draws use ALARM's exact assignment; the enacted plan uses precinct representative-point assignment, bounded at 0.12pp at district level.
